title: Released AI impact assessment
summary: I released the platform's second capability, which shows which requirements a change touches so teams re-verify only what changed.
what_would_have_happened: Teams would re-verify every requirement each release, whatever had changed.
the_call: Build each capability on the same trace graph, one release at a time.
what_i_did: Shipped impact assessment as the second release, then built the third release on top of it.
what_changed: Teams could see which requirements a change touched before deciding what to re-verify.
